product.olivetti-echos-p90s.summary: The Echos P90S in the Italian Pentium line with a 11.8-inch display.
product.olivetti-echos-p90s.history: MCmicrocomputer documented the Echos P90S in December 1995 in Olivetti’s multimedia Echos P line. It listed an Italian price of 8,760,000–9,450,000 lire excluding VAT.
product.olivetti-echos-p90s.architecture: The bay accepted different accessories. The review documents a CD-ROM, floppy drive or second battery, plus PCI video and two Type II or one Type III PCMCIA slots.
product.olivetti-echos-p90s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p90s.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
